verses.text: A song of ascents. By David. If the LORD hadn’t been on our side, let Israel say it now,
if the LORD hadn’t been on our side when people rose against us,
they would’ve swallowed us alive when their anger flared up at us.
The flood would’ve swept us away. The current would’ve gone right over us.
Those raging waters would’ve swallowed us up.
Blessed be the LORD, who didn’t leave us for their teeth to tear apart.
We got out like a bird escaping a hunter’s trap. The trap broke, and we got away.
Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
